STAR #2 scaffold · insight that narrowed the analysis (read aloud once)

lines.text: Situation: On the HKU ageing-friendly city project, our regression needed a distance buffer around each public housing estate, but we didn't know how far older residents actually travelled.
lines.gloss: S = context, one or two sentences
lines.translation: 情境: 回归分析需要缓冲距离，但不知道长者实际活动范围

lines.text: Task: My job was to find out when and where older residents were active, so the team could set a realistic buffer.
lines.gloss: T = YOUR job + why it mattered
lines.translation: 任务: 找出长者何时、何地活动

lines.text: Action: I analysed the street view detections by season and by distance from each estate, using Python and ArcGIS Pro, and appraised the patterns against our protocol.
lines.gloss: A = what YOU did; say the tools clearly
lines.translation: 行动: 按季节和距离分析检测结果

lines.text: The key insight was that older residents were mainly active in spring and winter, and mostly within two to three MTR stations of home.
lines.translation: 关键发现: 春冬活跃，2–3 个港铁站范围内

lines.text: Result: This allowed the team to narrow down the distance buffer, so the regression focused on the area that really mattered.
lines.translation: 结果: 团队缩小缓冲区，回归更聚焦

lines.text: If I did it again, I would share the pattern with the team earlier, as a quick chart.
lines.translation: 反思: 更早用图表分享

tasks.prompt: 1) If STAR #1 clean take is still open: one take (~90 s, number = 98% coverage), then move on. 2) STAR #2 aloud ~90 s from the scaffold, glancing as little as possible; include ‘The key insight was that…’ and ‘This allowed the team to…’. 3) Say ArcGIS Pro (ark-JEE-eye-ess), regression, geospatial ×3 each. 4) Bonus 20 s: your 60-sec intro first line + ‘I'm keen to bring…’ closing.
